(4 items) Adds 3-129 Weapon and Spell Damage

(5 items) Dealing damage with Burning Light twice within |cffffff30|r seconds creates a |cffffff5|r meter area |cffffff3.5|r meters in front of you for |cffffff5|r seconds.

Dealing damage an Aedric Spear skill within the area launches a spear at your target, dealing |cffffff1684|r Magic Damage and applying Sundered and increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff300|r for |cffffff10|r seconds. The damage scales off the higher of your Weapon or Spell Damage.
